description: This file defines the class SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner, which contains multiple test methods for verifying subscription behaviors in Orleans streaming infrastructure, including subscription matching, resubscription, concurrent subscriptions, and stream handling.

classes.name: SubscriptionMultiplicityTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class providing various streaming subscription test scenarios in Orleans, including parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, deactivation, multiple streams, and client subscription tests.

methods.name: MultipleParallelSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests multiple parallel subscriptions to a stream and verifies message production and consumption counts.

methods.name: MultipleLinearSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests sequential subscriptions and unsubscriptions to a stream, verifying correct behavior of start/stop producing and counting.

methods.name: MultipleSubscriptionTest_AddRemove
methods.description: Tests adding and removing subscriptions dynamically and checks if the counts update accordingly.

methods.name: ResubscriptionTest
methods.description: Tests resuming a subscription after cancellation without loss of message counts.

methods.name: ResubscriptionAfterDeactivationTest
methods.description: Tests resuming a subscription after the consumer grain has been deactivated, ensuring resilience.

methods.name: ActiveSubscriptionTest
methods.description: Creates multiple active subscriptions, verifies they are all tracked, then removes some and verifies counts.

methods.name: TwoIntermitentStreamTest
methods.description: Simulates sending messages on two different streams alternately, verifying correct message handling.

methods.name: SubscribeFromClientTest
methods.description: Tests client-based subscription to a stream and verifies message counting and unsubscription.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Internal helper method to verify consumption and production counters match expectations.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Internal helper method to repeatedly execute an async function within a specified timeframe.
